In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
feminist consciousness is a complex phenomenon that cannot be captured by a single indicator.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the feminist consciousness of women is a complex phenomenon, with a number of dimensions that may be measured and that may be used to predict feminist identity.
women who are more conscious of their oppression and of the oppression of other groups are more likely to identify themselves as feminists.
the feminist identity process involves the development of a consciousness that includes awareness of the nature of the social world as well as a sense of personal identity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
feminist consciousness is more than a label or a self-identification; it is a complex and multidimensional phenomenon that is best measured with multiple indicators.
women's consciousness is not a unitary phenomenon.
